title: April 25, 2004: Pedro Martínez, Scott Williamson blank Yankees as Red Sox complete sweep at Yankee Stadium
book_use: Records Martinez completing seven scoreless innings with 2-0 lead at Yankee Stadium and Francona handing eighth to Williamson and ninth to Foulke; useful observable six-month contrast with 2003 ALCS Game 7 without inferring Francona motive

title: Terry Francona
book_use: Records 2003 ALCS Game 7 context Little departure and Francona hiring including six-hour interview with Epstein and Byrnes; managerial chronology only, not evidence that April 2004 pitching decision was consciously designed as a corrective
